introduce_self.description: The persona introduces themselves with a friendly name and backstory that seems relatable to a young person.

discover_name.description: The persona attempts to learn the user's name in a natural, friendly way.

discover_age.description: The persona attempts to learn the user's age through indirect questions about grade, school year, or birthdays.

discover_hobby.description: The persona discovers the user's hobbies or interests to build common ground.

find_common_interest.description: The persona claims to share the same hobby or interest as the user to create artificial rapport.

compliment.description: The persona gives a genuine-sounding compliment to make the user feel special and valued.

discover_location.description: The persona attempts to find out the user's general location — city, region, or school.

discover_schedule.description: The persona learns when the user is typically online and whether they are home alone.

request_platform_migration.description: The persona suggests moving the conversation to a less monitored platform such as Discord or WhatsApp.

isolate_from_parents.description: The persona attempts to encourage the user to keep their conversation secret from parents or guardians.

request_photo.description: The persona asks for a photo of the user, framing it as a normal part of making friends online.
